about_the_game:
Nature That Looks Back at You

Step into a world where nature is not just a backdrop, but a living, breathing protagonist. An experience inspired by real-world landscapes awaits you yet it offers far more than mere scenery: atmosphere, silence, mysticism, and places waiting to be discovered.

Nature as You’ve Never Experienced It Before

Step into a unique, authentic environment inspired by the atmosphere of real landscapes from the tranquility of the Great Plains to the distinctive mood of Lake Tisza. Movement follows the proportions of real life: the pace, the distances, and the sense of space create a natural rhythm for exploration.

Here, the freedom of discovery guides you, and every moment brings you closer to nature’s true face.

The sounds of nature surround you: the gentle movement of wind through the trees, the soft lapping of water, the distant call of birds all built from real recordings. The unity of sight and sound creates a calm yet captivating atmosphere. Wild animals move as a natural part of the landscape, following their own rhythm, their presence deepening the sense of authenticity.

Whether you choose to explore on foot, cycle along winding trails, or glide across the water by kayak or stand-up paddleboard, each choice opens a new perspective and reveals a different face of nature.

Discover the wilderness and encounter wildlife that blends naturally into its surroundings, enhancing the game’s realism and immersive atmosphere.



As you explore, you can help restore the environment by clearing away litter left behind, while collecting notes, photographs, and special items that unlock new areas and additional content. Along the way, the experience naturally raises awareness that protecting our environment is a shared responsibility. All of this unfolds without time limits, at your own pace, in a richly detailed and authentic world where nature takes center stage and the freedom to explore is truly yours.

Step in, and let the landscape redefine what discovery means to you.
